name: @circle/desktop
description: Circle desktop application with its bundled agent runtime

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm --prefix ../workbench run build && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.test: node --test test/policy.test.ts test/capture.test.ts test/sandbox-guard.test.ts test/msi.test.ts test/channel.test.ts test/attention.test.ts test/harness.test.mjs test/update-harness.test.mjs test/developer-toolchain.test.mjs
scripts.test:live: node test/live.mjs && node test/browser-live.mjs && node test/browser-coordinate-live.mjs && node test/ui-issues.mjs && node test/session-management.mjs && node test/parallel-sessions.mjs && node test/network-native.mjs && node test/connection-issues.mjs
scripts.test:desktop: node --test test/browser-state.test.mjs test/desktop-readiness.test.mjs && node test/desktop.mjs && node test/browser-page.mjs && node test/browser-lifecycle.mjs && node test/browser-address.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src test scripts package.json tsconfig.json
